name: Crazy 4 Poker
description: Crazy 4 Poker (Buy Your Card) is a stud poker variant where players ante, receive five cards (two down, three up), then have three rounds of buying followed by betting. Players can pay 1, 2, 3, or 4 units to replace a card from four options (three face-up cards and the top of the deck). High-low with declaration; best hand wins.

rules.objective: Form the best five-card high hand, low hand, or both (declare high, low, or both). Win the pot by having the best hand at showdown or by making opponents fold.
rules.gameplay: Players ante; dealer deals five cards each (two face down, three face up) and places three face-up cards plus the deck as the buy row (prices 1, 2, 3, 4 units from left to deck). Three buying rounds: each player in turn may buy one card (discard one, pay price, take replacement), stand pat, or fold. Face-up bought cards are replaced from the deck. After each buying round, a betting round starts with the player showing the best hand. After the third betting round, surviving players declare high, low, or both; then showdown and the pot is split between high and low winners.
keyRules: Five cards each: two hole cards, three upcards.
